integrity: Analytical proof and exact overlap-count computation accompany the finding. Finite exhaustive tests and a symbolic checker are supplementary. No independent audit or external validation has taken place.
scientific_limitations: Uniform unrestricted linear permutations and unstandardized pattern count covariance, every integer sample size at least four. No CLT, independence, nonuniform Mallows result, or externally established historical priority is asserted. Existing single-pattern variance formulas are credited. Implicit coverage in older multivariate generating-function work remains possible.
title: Exact covariance spectrum of the six consecutive triple patterns in uniform permutations
